title: Step 1 - Thompson Sampling vs UCB: Optimizing Ad Click-Through Rates in R

cues.en: -: Hello, and welcome to this audio tutorial.
cues.zh: 講師：大家好，歡迎來到 R 教學。

cues.en: So in the previous section, we introduced a multi-armed banded problem for this ads clickthrough rate optimization problem, and we already tried two algorithms.
cues.zh: 上一單元為廣告點閱率最佳化，介紹多臂吃角子老虎問題，已試兩種演算法。

cues.zh: 第一個是簡單隨機選擇，每回合純隨機選廣告，

cues.en: and this algorithm gave us a total reward of 1,200 on average, because there is this random factor, but on average we got 1,200 total reward.
cues.zh: 平均總獎勵 1,200，因為有隨機因素，但平均是 1,200。

cues.en: And of course, when we plotted the histogram, every ad was selected more or less the same number of times.
cues.zh: 畫長條分布圖，當然每個廣告被選次數差不多。

cues.en: And then we tried another algorithm, which was the upper confidence bound algorithm, and there, we got much better results.
cues.zh: 接著試 UCB 信賴上界，結果好得多。

cues.en: Because not only we managed to almost double the total reward, because we got a total reward of 2,178.
cues.zh: 不僅總獎勵幾乎加倍，得到 2,178。

cues.en: So almost the double of what we obtained with the random selection, and the even better thing is that we managed to figure out which ad version was the best
cues.zh: 接近隨機兩倍，更棒的是，找出哪個版本最適合

cues.en: to show to the user.
cues.zh: 顯示給使用者。

cues.en: That is, which ad version had the highest conversion rate.
cues.zh: 也就是轉換率最高的版本。

cues.en: The highest CTR, that is the highest click through rate.
cues.zh: 最高 CTR，點閱率。

cues.zh: 這單元試新演算法，叫 Thompson 抽樣。

cues.zh: 會看兩件事。

cues.en: Let's see.
cues.zh: 看看。

cues.zh: 第二，是否找到相同的最高轉換率版本。
